item.title: Samsung Hikes Galaxy S26 Prices $100‑$200 – What’s Next
item.description: Samsung has increased the price of its Galaxy S26, S26+ and S26 Ultra models by $100‑$200, with the 1TB Ultra now $2,000. We explore the reasons and market impact.
